title: Backblaze Hard Drive Data and Stats, raw daily drive records 2023-Q1 .. 2025-Q4
population: Backblaze data-centre drives (HDD data drives and SSD boot drives), one row per drive per day
notes: Downloaded from f001.backblazeb2.com (12 quarterly zips, ~12 GB, not in git); aggregated by scripts/fault_library/extract_backblaze.py into derived/backblaze_model_age.csv.gz and derived/backblaze_summary.json. failure = 1 on the drive's last day when it was removed as failed.

measurements.metric_verbatim: per-model drive-days and failures by age quarter (SMART 9)
